description: Defines the TickLabels class for chart axis label formatting in the MigraDoc library, including properties for style, format, and font, as well as serialization and deep copy functionality.

classes.name: TickLabels
classes.description: Represents axis tick label formatting, including style, format, and font, with serialization and cloning capabilities.

classes.name: TickLabelsValues
classes.description: Holds internal nullable property values for TickLabels, such as Style, Format, and Font.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the TickLabels instance.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Performs a deep copy of the TickLabels object, including cloning the Font if present.
